text.en: Believing gluons, like photons, carry no charge of their own and so don't interact with each other directly — gluons do carry colour charge and interact with each other directly, a self-interaction with no electromagnetic counterpart, and it's exactly this self-interaction that produces colour confinement.
text.et: Arvamus, et gluoonid, nagu footonid, ei kanna oma laengut ega seetõttu interakteeru üksteisega otse — gluoonid kannavad värvilaengut ja interakteeruvad üksteisega otse, isetoime, millel pole elektromagnetilist vastet, ning just see isetoime tekitabki värvuse konfinemendi.
